# gigahost_dns_dnssec (Resource)

Toggles DNSSEC on a registered .no domain hosted on Gigahost nameservers. For externally hosted domains use `gigahost_dns_zone` nameserver configuration and submit DS records via the DynDNS / Norid channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.no"
  type = "NATIVE"
}

resource "gigahost_dns_dnssec" "example" {
  zone_id = gigahost_dns_zone.example.id
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) `true` to enable DNSSEC; `false` to disable.
- `zone_id` (String) ID of the zone.

### Read-Only

- `ds_records` (String) DS records fetched from /dns/zones/{id}/ds-records. Populated when enabled is true.
- `id` (String) Alias of `zone_id` to satisfy the Terraform resource model.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Find the zone ID (or use the zone name directly):
#   gigahost dns zones list
terraform import gigahost_dns_dnssec.example ZONE_ID
# ...or import by zone name:
terraform import gigahost_dns_dnssec.example example.no
```
